title: Ethernet's fastest standard rate, 1973–2024
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of the top data rate of Ethernet at each step. The experimental Ethernet at Xerox PARC, 1973: 2.94 Mbit/s. IEEE 802.3 (10BASE5), approved 1983: 10 Mbit/s. 802.3u Fast Ethernet, 1995: 100 Mbit/s. 802.3z Gigabit Ethernet, 1998: 1 Gbit/s. 802.3ae, 2002: 10 Gbit/s. 802.3ba, 2010: 100 Gbit/s. 802.3bs, 2017: 400 Gbit/s. 802.3df, 2024: 800 Gbit/s. Dates are IEEE approval dates. Data: IEEE 802.3 and Ethernet, Wikipedia.
heading: ETHERNET'S TOP RATE · MBIT/S · LOG SCALE
